title: Account takeover via phishing
scenario: Credential phishing against staff compromises a Google Workspace or AWS console account because MFA is not enforced for all users, exposing customer analytics data.
existing_controls: Google Workspace 2SV available but optional; AWS IAM Identity Center with MFA for engineers
planned_controls: Enforce 2SV for all Workspace users (security keys for admins); phishing-resistant MFA for AWS; quarterly phishing simulation

title: Unpatched laptops miss the 14-day window
scenario: macOS and browser updates are deferred by staff, leaving critical vulnerabilities unpatched beyond 14 days on laptops with access to production data.
existing_controls: Jamf deployed to ~80% of laptops; auto-update not enforced
planned_controls: Enrol 100% of laptops in Jamf; enforce OS/browser update deadlines ≤14 days; monthly patch compliance report

title: BYOD phones accessing email without controls
scenario: Personal phones access Gmail and Slack without screen lock or OS update requirements; a lost or outdated device exposes customer data and fails Cyber Essentials scope.
planned_controls: Google endpoint management basic/advanced for BYOD: screen lock, OS version minimum, remote wipe of work profile

title: Leaver retains access to SaaS tools
scenario: Leaver offboarding relies on a Slack message to IT; access to secondary SaaS tools (BI, CRM, design) is not consistently removed.
existing_controls: Google account suspended on last day
planned_controls: HiBob-triggered offboarding checklist; SSO for top 10 SaaS; quarterly access review

title: Customer data exposed by AWS misconfiguration
scenario: A misconfigured S3 bucket or security group exposes retailer customer data because infrastructure changes are not consistently reviewed and there is no configuration monitoring.
existing_controls: Terraform for most infrastructure; S3 Block Public Access at account level
planned_controls: Enable AWS Security Hub + Config with CIS benchmark; require PR review on all Terraform; alert on public resources

title: Secrets committed to source code
scenario: API keys or database credentials are committed to GitHub repositories and leaked, enabling unauthorised access to production.
existing_controls: AWS Secrets Manager used for production secrets
planned_controls: Enable GitHub secret scanning + push protection on all repos; rotate any historic findings

title: Ransomware or deletion of production data
scenario: Ransomware or a malicious insider deletes production databases and backups held in the same AWS account, causing extended outage and data loss.
existing_controls: Automated RDS snapshots (same account); no restore test performed
planned_controls: Cross-account, immutable backups (AWS Backup Vault Lock); annual restore test with recorded RTO/RPO

title: Customer personal data entered into AI assistant
scenario: The in-product 'Insights Assistant' sends retailer customer personal data to a third-party LLM API, creating unlawful processing, transfer and retention risk and breaching customer DPAs.
existing_controls: Zero data retention option enabled on LLM API account; prompts include aggregated metrics only by design
planned_controls: Complete DPIA and AI impact assessment; add PII redaction before LLM calls; list LLM provider as subprocessor; update DPAs

title: Staff paste confidential data into public AI tools
scenario: Staff use personal accounts on public AI chat tools for work and paste customer data or source code, leaking confidential information.
existing_controls: Company Claude Team workspace available; no AI use policy
planned_controls: AI acceptable use policy; approved-tools list; block or monitor unapproved AI domains on managed devices

title: No tested incident response capability
scenario: A security incident or personal data breach is mishandled because there is no documented, exercised incident response plan, missing the 72-hour notification window.
existing_controls: Informal on-call via PagerDuty for availability incidents only
planned_controls: Incident response policy and plan incl. personal data breach handling; tabletop exercise; breach log

title: Critical supplier failure or breach
scenario: A breach or outage at a critical supplier (AWS, LLM API provider, Google) affects Acme's service and customer data, with no supplier risk assessment or exit plan.
existing_controls: Contracts with major providers on standard terms; no supplier register
planned_controls: Supplier register with criticality; annual review of SOC 2/ISO reports for critical suppliers; subprocessor list published

title: Single point of knowledge for security
scenario: Security knowledge and admin access sit with the Head of Engineering; their absence would stall incident response and the certification programme.
planned_controls: Document runbooks; second admin for critical systems; consider fractional CISO support
